definitions.explanation: A streak of light in the night sky caused by a small piece of space debris burning up as it enters Earth's atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {流|なが}れ{星|ぼし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}たら→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{願|ねが}い{事|ごと}→願い事：14621_negaigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: If you see a shooting star, make a wish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨夜|さくや}→昨夜：02999_sakuya⟧、{流|なが}れ{星|ぼし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{横切|よこぎ}る→横切る：02326_yokogiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: Last night, I saw a shooting star streak across the sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦{流星群|りゅうせいぐん}→流星群：20408_ryuuseigun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{流|なが}れ{星|ぼし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: On nights of meteor showers, you can see many shooting stars.

notes:
{流|なが}れ{星|ぼし} refers to shooting stars or meteors. ⟦{流|なが}れ→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧ means 'flowing' and ⟦{星|ぼし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧ means 'star.'

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {流|なが}れ{星|ぼし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to see a shooting star
- {流|なが}れ{星|ぼし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{願|ねが}い→願い：03529_negai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to make a wish on a shooting star
- {流|なが}れ{星|ぼし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧: a shooting star falls

METEOR SHOWERS (⟦{流星群|りゅうせいぐん}→流星群：20408_ryuuseigun⟧):
- ペルセウス⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧⟦{流星群|りゅうせいぐん}→流星群：20408_ryuuseigun⟧: Perseids (August)
- ふたご⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧⟦{流星群|りゅうせいぐん}→流星群：20408_ryuuseigun⟧: Geminids (December)
- しぶんぎ⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧⟦{流星群|りゅうせいぐん}→流星群：20408_ryuuseigun⟧: Quadrantids (January)

SCIENTIFIC TERMS:
- ⟦{流星|りゅうせい}→流星：06310_ryuusei⟧: meteor (scientific)
- ⟦{隕石|いんせき}→隕石：05054_inseki⟧: meteorite (if it reaches ground)

CULTURAL NOTE:
- In Japan, it's believed that if you make a wish before a shooting star disappears, it will come true
